subject: Making PR's run unstable and latest only, adding a daily job for all versions (#101)
reason: The change modifies only CI configuration (.github/workflows/ci.yml: a daily scheduled job, dynamic server-version matrix discovery, setup-python bump) and build.sh (dynamic SERVER_VERSION validation via git ls-remote, reordered lint/test steps). No module source code is touched: no command, reply, encoding, persistence or replication behavior of valkey-bloom changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario against running servers could reach or detect.
